failures.reason: The first PowerShell skill-size projection placed a pipeline directly after a foreach block and raised an empty-pipe parser error.
failures.recovery: Materialize the projection rows first and serialize the resulting array separately.

failures.reason: A combined source baton and failure-dossier display exceeded the bounded presentation surface and was truncated.
failures.recovery: Verify the baton byte, word, digest and EOF scalar separately and parse the complete dossier structurally without broad display.

failures.reason: Some parallel reference projections returned blank presentation blocks even though the literal files existed.
failures.recovery: Read each required literal reference individually through EOF.

failures.reason: The first read-only exact-blob verifier used a stale guessed manifests directory and Git rejected the nonexistent path before evaluating any binding.
failures.recovery: Resolve manifest paths from the exact source tree and rerun only the missing path dependency; 392 exact bindings then passed.

failures.reason: An unquoted PowerShell upstream revision token was parsed as a script block while checking divergence.
failures.recovery: Quote HEAD...@{upstream}; the narrow readback returned typed 0/0 divergence.

failures.reason: A bounded read-only source search used a bare assignment name instead of a PowerShell variable and was rejected.
failures.recovery: Discard the malformed projection and use literal git tree paths; repository bytes were unchanged.
